reviewedBy: Dr. K. M. Rahman (Poultry Disease Specialist, DVM, MS)
disclaimer: Meat cockerels (Gallus gallus domesticus) require aggressive early protection against Newcastle and Gumboro diseases, plus adequate floor space to prevent aggression.

stages.name: Brooding
tips: Brooding temperature must be kept steady during first 10 days.
Provide electrolyte and multi-vitamin water on arrival.
Keep drinkers clean and check daily for wet spots in brooding rings.

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease (ND Clone 30 / BCRDV) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 eye-drop per chick. Keep vaccine vials chilled on crushed ice.

milestones.title: Gumboro (IBD Intermediate) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop of Gumboro vaccine in eye. Confirm drop absorption before releasing bird.

stages.name: Growing Phase
stages.feed: Cockerel Grower Mash / Pellets (19% crude protein)
tips: Cockerels are active and energetic; ensure adequate feeder and drinker spacing to prevent feather pecking.
Ensure good cross-ventilation to remove dust and humidity.

milestones.title: Gumboro (IBD) Drinking Water Booster
milestones.instructions: Withdraw water for 2 hours, mix vaccine with non-chlorinated water and skimmed milk powder (2g/L).

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease (ND LaSota) Drinking Water Booster
milestones.instructions: Administer live ND LaSota in clean morning drinking water. Ensure full consumption within 2 hours.

milestones.title: Day 30 Growth & Uniformity Weighing
milestones.instructions: Sample 5% of cockerels (target: 350-420g). Check breast muscle development.

milestones.title: Mid-Cycle Deworming Routine
milestones.instructions: Administer broad-spectrum anthelmintic (e.g. Levamisole or Albendazole) in drinking water according to flock weight.

stages.name: Hardening & Finishing
tips: Keep sheds well-ventilated during hot afternoons.
Maintain clean, dry bedding to preserve footpad health and shank coloration.
Monitor live bird weight progression weekly.

milestones.title: Fowl Cholera (Pasteurella multocida) Booster
milestones.instructions: Administer inactivated Fowl Cholera vaccine subcutaneously according to manufacturer instructions.

milestones.title: Day 60 Pre-Harvest Weighing
milestones.instructions: Sample 50 birds (target: 850-1000g). Project slaughter or live trade dispatch date.

milestones.title: Final Market Harvest Weighing & Batch Close
milestones.instructions: Record final flock average weight (target: 1.1-1.3 kg), birds sold, and gross revenue.
